<style>

.semicon-button.sub{background:#f8fafc;color:#075985!important;border:1px solid #b8d8f4}
.semicon-conversion{background:#ecfdf5;border:2px solid #86efac;border-radius:16px;padding:1.2em;margin:1.6em 0}
.semicon-conversion strong{display:block;color:#14532d;font-size:1.12em;margin-bottom:0.4em}
.semicon-conversion .buttons{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:0.8em}
.semicon-cardgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin:1.2em 0}
.semicon-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:1.05em;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.55em}
.semicon-card-head{display:flex;gap:0.6em;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
.semicon-level{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:28px;padding:0.22em 0.7em;border-radius:999px;font-size:0.85em;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap}
.lv-zero{background:#e0f2fe;color:#075985}.lv-beginner{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534}.lv-mid{background:#fff7ed;color:#9a3412}.lv-career{background:#ede9fe;color:#5b21b6}.lv-company{background:#fce7f3;color:#9d174d}
.semicon-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:28px;padding:0.22em 0.7em;border-radius:999px;background:#f1f5f9;color:#475569;font-size:0.82em;font-weight:800}
.semicon-card-title{font-size:1.06em;line-height:1.55;margin:0}
.semicon-card-desc{color:#526071;font-size:0.95em;line-height:1.72;margin:0}
.semicon-next{color:#334155;font-size:0.9em;line-height:1.65;margin:0;padding-top:0.35em;border-top:1px dashed #dbe7f5}
.semicon-route{background:#f0f9ff;border:2px solid #7dd3fc;border-radius:16px;padding:1.15em;margin:1.6em 0}
.semicon-route ol{margin:0;padding-left:1.3em}
.semicon-route li{margin:0.35em 0}
.semicon-backtop{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:86px;z-index:10;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:999px;background:#075985;color:#fff!important;text-decoration:none!important;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(15,23,42,.24)}
@media (max-width:820px){

  .semicon-index h2{font-size:1.22em;padding:0.8em 0.9em}

  .semicon-hero,.semicon-action,.semicon-conversion{padding:1em}
  .semicon-card{padding:1em}
  .semicon-backtop{right:12px;bottom:78px;width:46px;height:46px}
